segments.name: Enterprise, Education, and Technology
segments.description: Serves customers using Kaltura's platform for customer-, employee-, and learner-facing rich media use cases such as buyer enablement, recruiting, learning, and teaching.
segments.evidence: This segment encompasses customers utilizing Kaltura's solutions to deliver agentic rich-media experiences for their customers, employees, and learners such as buyer enablement, employee recruiting, learning and teaching.

segments.name: Media and Telecom
segments.description: Serves media companies and telecom providers delivering entertainment and streaming experiences to consumer audiences.
segments.evidence: The M&T segment includes revenue from customers using Kaltura to deliver entertainment and streaming use cases to their audiences, along with the associated professional services.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay subscription fees for the platform plus professional services; telecom TV customers pay per end-subscriber and media customers pay on a platform usage-license basis.
revenueModel.evidence: For customers of our telecom TVCMS and TV Streaming Applications, revenue is recognized primarily on a per end‑subscriber basis, while media customers leveraging our Online Video Platform are billed on a platform usage‑license basis.
